macro_regime.description: Classifies the current market environment each morning. Overrides cash_reserve_pct and min_buy_score for the day's run.

risk_off.label: 🔴 Risk-Off
risk_off.note: In risk_off mode, only rotations (existing high-score replacement) are allowed. No net new exposure.

macro_regime.vix_source: Search web for current VIX value via CBOE or finviz.com
macro_regime.spx_ma_source: Search web for SPX 50-day moving average vs current price via finviz.com or macrotrends.net

exclusions.notes: Penny stocks filtered by min_stock_price ($5). Chinese ADRs and meme stocks by blocked_symbols list + agent judgment.

wolff_simulation.description: Runs a parallel, simulated copy of Peter Wolff's Flagship Fund starting with $1,000 cash. No real orders are submitted for this strategy.

ark_simulation.description: Runs a parallel, simulated copy of ARK Invest's ARKK flagship ETF starting with $1,000 cash. Tracks ARK's daily disclosed holdings. No real orders are submitted for this strategy.
ark_simulation.fallback_source: ETF.com ARKK holdings page if CSV unavailable

schedule.description: 10:00 AM ET (EDT) / 7:00 AM PT, Monday through Friday
schedule.timezone_note: During EST (Nov-Mar), change to '0 15 * * 1-5' for 10:00 AM ET
